label: IOLAN SCS16 secure console server, 16 x RS232, dual GbE
description: 16-port secure console server: sixteen RJ45 RS232 (EIA232, IOLAN pinout) serial ports and two independent 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet ports, with a PCI slot for an optional V.92 modem card. Redundant network paths to the same serial estate.
notes: Perle product page: 'IOLAN SCS16 Secure Console Server: 16 x RJ45 RS232 ports with IOLAN pinout, EIA232 interface, Dual 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet, PCI slot for V.92 modem card'. Dual gigabit is the point of this entry: the Moxa NPort 6650-16 has one 10/100 uplink, so a console server pair here can be cabled to two switches and survive a single link or switch failure - the actual reason people pay for this class of box. The V.92 modem card and the SCS16C-DSFP variant (two SFP slots instead of the copper pair, per Perle's launch note) are options and are not modelled; only what ships as the base unit is. RS232 only - unlike the Moxa 5650/6650 family there is no RS-422/485 mode on this SKU, which matters if a lab needs to console an industrial device.
